newsitem.title: GREECE: KAPPA SECURITIES ADVISOR ON ILIOFIN SALE.
newsitem.headline: KAPPA SECURITIES ADVISOR ON ILIOFIN SALE.

text.p: Athens stock exchange member Kappa Securities was the advisor on the sale of a majority 66.67 percent stake in Iliofin by National Bank to entrepreneurs Hatzioannou.

Kappa along with National Securities crossed a block of 821,248 common and 56,680 preferred shares -- 66.67 percent stakes -- of dye and finishing firm Iliofin at 1,504 and 1,705 drachmas respectively.

The Hatzioannou brothers own a hosiery manufacturing concern that puts out hosiery products under the brands Venus Victoria, Belinda and Diane with 1996 sales of 10 billion drachmas and profits of 1.0 billion.
Their other business interests also include a 50 percent stake in the Xanthi Casino. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
